scientific_question: Within each AreCEL dataset, compare PostgreSQL cardinality-estimation error on official test queries for resource sets selected by validation-calibrated Empty, Nominal, and PESS policies.
minimum_experiment_sentence: Reuse the pinned AreCEL official splits, Issue #59 candidate universe, corrected PR #58 model functions, and the existing PG sample-replay runner; add only a truth-firewalled workload reader, full-split calibration/evaluation loop, Plan Rows Q1 output, and compact query-level observations needed for the stated comparison.

scope_reset.self_generated_cohort_route: SUPERSEDED_FOR_THIS_QUESTION; preserve prior protocol, ledger, and feasibility reports unchanged as historical work
scope_reset.template_disjointness: not required; do not claim generalization to unseen templates
scope_reset.dataset_transfer: none; calibrate and report each table separately
scope_reset.test_exposure: prior Issue #48 outcomes exposed 60 Forest10 and 52 Census13 test identities; classify those identities from frozen identity protocols, retain them in the official test set, report the exposed/unexposed identity strata separately, and do not use prior outcomes to tune any choice
scope_reset.historical_overlap: Issue #59 reports train/valid/test template overlap; treat the official split as the target benchmark and disclose overlap rather than filtering queries or claiming independent template groups

official_inputs.identity: archive.py emits arecel:{dataset}:{split}:{source_index:06d}; preserve this source index and source-SQL hash as query ID integrity fields
official_inputs.identity_preflight: compare each workload split's unique IDs/counts and source-SQL hashes with the pinned official source using workload definitions only; do not read label_pickle_sha256 inputs during this preflight

selection.calibration_queries: all 10000 official valid queries per dataset; train is development-only and never required for selection
selection.candidate_policy: use the exact per-dataset pairwise MCV candidates and frozen candidate order in the pinned Issue #59 protocol; do not add pairs or transfer candidates across tables
selection.cost: one proxy unit per candidate statistics object; not physical ANALYZE cost
selection.calibration_measurements: one Empty and one singleton per candidate on the same frozen dataset sample; use valid truth only to compute the existing corrected-log model inputs; select one deterministic set per method/budget and record all optimal ties
selection.objective_and_ties: reuse PR #58 corrected-log model, Nominal greedy matching in frozen candidate order, and PESS maximal-matching objective; exact Fraction reference for recorded rationalized inputs; select lexicographically smallest candidate-ID tuple and retain all tied sets

corrected_log_source_pin.reuse_boundary: verify these pins against PR #58 before adaptation; reuse model definitions only, not old calibration records or selected sets

evaluation.split: all 10000 official test queries per dataset, with one observation per query/treatment
evaluation.query: the existing AreCEL single-table predicate query; retain >2 predicates and do not filter by candidate-edge coverage, operator, or prior overlap
evaluation.test_truth_firewall: freeze this config, source/code pins, valid-derived selections, and evaluation schedule before materializing or reading any test label, estimate, plan, or trace; separate researcher approval is required before any test execution or outcome access
evaluation.primary_estimator: integer Plan Rows on the top-level EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON) plan node, which estimates output rows for the AreCEL SELECT * query; reject malformed, missing, negative, or nonintegral values
evaluation.primary_metric: per-dataset nearest-rank P95 Q1, Q1(E,A)=max(E,A,1)/max(min(E,A),1), for nonnegative integer Plan Rows E and AreCEL truth A
evaluation.zero_and_invalid: retain raw E=0 and A=0 values/status; Q1 is defined for nonnegative values; missing, negative, nonintegral, or nonfinite estimate/truth is INVALID and is never dropped or replaced
secondary: floor-one MALE = mean(abs(ln(max(E,1))-ln(max(A,1)))) over all valid nonnegative integer pairs; additionally report natural MALE = mean(abs(ln(E/A))) on the E>0,A>0 subset and its n
paired per-query Q1 benefit/harm/tie counts for PESS versus Nominal; compare exact Q1 values, no tolerance
evaluation.quantile_and_repetition: one fixed sample per dataset, replayed byte-identically for every treatment; one Plan Rows observation per query/treatment; no averaging across repetitions; nearest-rank quantile at rank ceil(p*n); no population confidence/significance claim
evaluation.exposure_reporting: report complete official test metrics and separately identify the frozen previously exposed query-ID subset; unexposed-subset results are a sensitivity description, not a new untouched confirmatory benchmark
evaluation.trace: no per-query trace required for Q1; capture a targeted trace only if making a claim about a statistic object actually selected by PostgreSQL; missing mechanism trace does not remove a valid Plan Rows observation
evaluation.raw_observations: retain compact query ID, treatment/set ID, Plan Rows, AreCEL truth, validity/status, and sample identity sufficient to recompute metrics; do not retain full plan/trace dumps unless a specific mechanism claim requires them

postgresql_target.boundary: Gate A is infrastructure evidence, not this experiment's runtime approval; reverify actual source commit, build flags, binary hashes and clean state before execution

outcome_free_plan_count.assumptions: full 10000 valid queries; one Empty plus every candidate singleton for calibration; full 10000 test queries; at most seven unique test treatment sets after deduplicating the shared budget-0 Empty plus up to two selected sets at each of budgets 2, 3, and 5; one sample and one estimate per query/treatment
outcome_free_plan_count.cap_status: EXISTING_RUNNER_CAP_PER_DATASET_IS_INSUFFICIENT; derive and approve execution/resource caps for full official splits before any measured phase

genuine_correctness_blockers_before_exec: The current AreCEL prepare() path unpickles the workload and the single all-split label pickle, then writes every split's truth.json. A valid-only calibration path must avoid exposing/materializing test labels before selection freeze; verify whether the pinned archive permits a valid-only extraction, otherwise this is a data-format/firewall blocker that must be resolved before selection.

The PR #58 runner reads only frozen small cohorts, requires positive pre-clamp trace estimates, and does not record Plan Rows as its metric input; adapt it for all official split IDs and the Q1 Plan Rows estimand, and validate top-level Plan Rows parsing with a small synthetic EXPLAIN JSON fixture.
The existing 1800-query-plan cap per dataset cannot cover the calculated full-split plan counts (140000/140000/180000/140000); set and approve a realistic runtime/disk/plan cap before execution.
